answer: The reamer opens the bung hole to the gauge, and the ream must run true or the bung seats crooked. Barrel cedar cask filler chestnut seal rules the reaming: a seal cedar cask fillers carry after filling room hearings. The falcon is the first ream, made at the head; the willow is the last, made before the heads are fitted, and the pigment is the head itself, bored and true. To fake it, a cheat must ream 17 false holes and fit 17 false heads.
